760050101.text: *cough cough* We finally made it out... Ugh, Paimon didn't expect that collapse... That was so scary! Good thing we managed to find another exit...

760050102.text: But with all that noise just now, Verna must have heard it too, right? Paimon had better hurry back and bring her here before she tries to dig into the cave. She might get herself trapped...

760050103.text: Taking advantage of her ability to fly, Paimon goes around the other side of the mountain and brings Verna over, all while explaining to her everything that just happened...

760050104.text: #Huh? It c—collapsed!? Oh no, how did this happen... {NICKNAME} and Paimon, are you both alright!?

760050105.text: You mean you didn't hear that huge noise just now?! And it's a little late to say "are you alright," isn't it? We're standing here, aren't we?

760050106.text: Haha, sorry... I was busy calibrating Kraka III, so I wasn't paying attention...

760050107.text: #Indeed, you have proven exceptionally trustworthy, {NICKNAME} — more so than even myself as a priestess. Had I encountered such circumstances, I fear I would have been at a complete loss.

760050108.text: #Alright, let's see what you've been up to, little Krakas... Well, aren't you a right troublemaker! You found the pieces, but didn't come back on time, so {NICKNAME} and Paimon had to turn this place upside down just looking for you!

760050109.text: Well, they found the pieces, but got stuck on their way back... Don't you think you might've messed the settings up somewhere, Verna?

760050110.text: Certainly not! I'm a direct apprentice of the famous "Papa Wrench," and the finest mechanic on Hiisi Island! There's no way I'd mess up a simple recall function... Nope! Definitely not!

760050111.text: Don't think Paimon didn't hear you hesitate! And let's face it — bad recall function or not, they didn't return, and that's a fact!

760050112.text: Oh, but they have returned. You two reliable souls did bring them back, didn't you? Now all we have to do is toss this fragment up like you did previously, and everything should go off without a hitch!

760050113.text: You're seriously sidestepping the issue here...

760050114.text: As the sacred prayer goes: "O, great father of genesis, forger of the{RUBY#[S]Takoja Ianikuinen} tripled moons! Let your wrath right that askew throne, that the fair one may become thy..."

760050115.text: Become thy... uh, what comes next?

760050116.text: Argh, forget the chant! Scientifically speaking, no matter the problem, a few good whacks will do the trick! Percussive maintenance, go!

760050118.text: That's right! Whether it's Treasure Hoarders, Specters, or troublemakers from who knows where — just whack 'em a few times and you're good to go...  Wait, how's any of this even remotely "scientific"?!

760050119.text: No matter how Paimon looks at it, something about this plan feels off... Are we sure we won't accidentally blow the whole island sky high?

760050120.text: Haha, you're a funny one, Paimon! Nobody would be silly enough to blow their own home apart, right?

760050123.text: Rest assured! I've been secretly... ahem, I mean, I've been thoroughly researching this for a long time, and can vouch that it is a very reliable plan! And we did test it once just now, didn't we?

760050124.text: *sigh* Guess we've got no choice but to try at this point...

760050122.text: Yeah... You can't phrase this in a way that doesn't sound risky!

Investigate Thunderclap Reef

760050401.text: Huh? Kraka III, you're back already?

760050402.text: That's weird. You didn't collect the fragment, so why are you here so soon...?

760050404.text: Ah! I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Please let me explain! There's a really good reason I'm dressed like this — it's not heresy or anything, I swear!

760050405.text: Wah! Paimon hasn't even said anything yet!

760050406.text: Huh? Oh, you're just an adventurer from the outside... By the Moon Goddess's silken locks, I thought you were— Wait a sec! Why are you dressed like that? And acting like it's totally normal, to boot!?

760050409.text: Wait... You must be... You're the one the Moon Ma{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}iden holds dear... Talented beyond belief and totally unfazed, even with all this <color=#00E1FFFF>kuuvahki turbulence</color>...

760050410.text: Uhh, about that... Well, Paimon thinks we can just skip over the details. But seriously, why are you dressed like that? What are you doing here? And what even is kuuvahki turbulence?

760050411.text: Ah, pardon my rudeness. Ahem! "I am she who serveth the Frost Moon, born of the tides, and bearer of the High Priestess's mantle beneath the moon's silver gaze. In this sublunary sphere, I am known as Vernadska."

760050412.text: But you two can just call me Verna. I'm currently on a very secret mission to restore balance to the kuuvahki here. So, if I may — how should I address you both?

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the cave and search for fragment(s)
Throw the fragment(s) at the stone

760050501.text: We found it! See? I told you to trust in the power of science...

760050503.text: Whoa! There's someone else here too!?

760050505.text: I am the dawn's first breath upon the world's weary brow, the final draught of nectar drawn from a bitter well. I am mother to all, and daughter to all...

760050507.text: Eh? Let me think... That does sound like part of a rite — but it's a verse only a Moonchanter is allowed to recite...

760050510.text: Hmph, a true priestess would never get the sequence of their prayers wrong. Another fraud in a borrowed robe — I've seen plenty of your kind!

760050511.text: Last time it was a woman called Hidimbi, she too dressed the part, played the role, and fooled quite a few...

760050512.text: But tough luck for you, imposter — you've got a real priestess right here! And I can see through your disguise!

760050513.text: ...Do the mask's carvings determine the actor's worth? What matters is that she sits in that seat, and thus she plays the role...

760050514.text: In this sublunary sphere, are we not all masked? It is merely that some veils can be seen, and others, not...

760050515.text: Woah... That sounds profound. If nothing else, she sounds more priestess-y than you, Verna...

760050516.text: Hey! What's that supposed to mean?

760050509.text: That does sound like part of a rite — but it's a verse only a Moonchanter is allowed to recite...

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the cave and search for fragment(s)

760050602.text: Get it right — It's heroes, plural! Now hand over the fragment, imposter!

760050605.text: ...Is what you seek not right before your eyes?

760050606.text: Haha, I knew you wouldn't give up without a fight! Guess I'll just have to give you that blessing to the head — Wait, what did you just say?

760050607.text: You're just... giving it to us? Then why have us come all this way in the first place?

760050608.text: Because this is where it must happen. Fate demands it. I have waited too long, endured too much, all for this moment. All for the birth of a "god"...

760050609.text: But it matters not. Soon it will end, and the newborn "god" will drape the world in true joy...

760050610.text: What are you even talking about?

760050611.text: ...Via... I have glimpsed it in the mirror of stars. There is no place for her in a world where the "god" has now been born...

760050612.text: First off, it's Verna, not Via! Don't you know it's rude to— Wait, you weren't talking about me, were you?

760050613.text: Indeed. So then — do what must be done. The ending you seek awaits.

760050614.text: Wait, wait, wait. We're not here to hurt you or anything! You're just so vague and cryptic all the time — it's getting on Paimon's nerves!

760050615.text: And what's with the kuuvahki turbulence around here? Why is that fragment in your hands? This "ending we seek" would sure be nice with an explanation of... well, anything!

760050616.text: ...Patience. Once all comes to an end, we will meet again.

760050618.text: You seek answers, do you not? When the moment comes, the path ahead will open.

760050619.text: Well then, I shall await you at the Court of the First Edict.

760050620.text: Huh? But isn't the Court of the First Edict already...

760050621.text: "O nightingale, O nightingale, who soars above pale ridges and frozen plains..."\n"Have you heard the songs of evening prayer? My dearest nightingale..."

760050623.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, watch out! Looks like something's woken up!

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the cave and search for fragment(s)

760050801.text: Argh! This is unbelievable! Who does this fraud think she is!? The nerve of her — taking control of a sacred Frostnight Scion and turning it against us...!

760050806.text: Anyway, first things first — let's gather the remaining kuuhenki on the island, extract the last fragment from the Moon Mirror, and stabilize the disturbance once and for all!

760050804.text: Y—Yeah... Paimon thinks there's a good chance that it was the lightning strikes from earlier that woke the Frostnight Scion up...

760050805.text: Well, then that, too, must've been her doing! If she can wield kuuvahki and knows our prayers inside and out, pulling off something like that would be a piece of cake!

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the cave and search for fragment(s)

760050901.text: Anyway, first things first — let's gather the remaining kuuhenki on the island, extract the last fragment from the Moon Mirror, and stabilize the disturbance once and for all!

760050701.text: W—What should we do? Doesn't look like we can leave through here... Wait, Paimon sees some light over there! Maybe there's another way around?

subQuests.subQuestName: Throw the fragment(s) at the stone

760051001.text: #Alright, my ever-reliable {NICKNAME} and Paimon, I'll be counting on you! Once you've collected the stone fragments, just toss them up onto those two large stones!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Verna

760051201.text: Ah! What's going on now? The kuuvahki feels even more unstable than before!

760051204.text: No need to panic! This is just... a minor technical issue. Nothing to worry about!

760051205.text: We've successfully adjusted the kuuvahki from a chaotic state to a reversed chaotic state. Now we just need to nudge it back to normal!

760051206.text: Think about it this way: If things have already gone from bad to incomprehensible, there's no room left for it to get any worse, right?

760051207.text: Your explanation is what's incomprehensible! How can you stay so calm when everything's falling apart?

760051208.text: B—Because panicking won't help! Staying calm... l—lets us think clearly and find a way out of this mess...

760051209.text: #I—I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I lied! I'm totally freaking out, I'm just trying to look like I'm not! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what in the Moon's name are we supposed to do!?

760051210.text: So you're just going to dump the problem on us now? Hey, if you're really a priestess of the Frostmoon Scions, don't you have some kinda prayer or spell that can stop the storm?

760051211.text: You say it like such things exist! Ugh. That's why we place our trust in science... Yes, we've still got science, don't we? Now let me check...

760051212.text: Aha, just as I suspected! Kraka III's readings suggest a source of faint kuuvahki traces nearby, almost identical to that of the other fragments.

760051213.text: If the first two fragments tipped the kuuvahki into a reversed chaotic state, then the third one should be able to bring it to a state of minimized turbulence... Yep, that has to be it!

760051214.text: #Ha! So it was just a miscalculation after all! I knew the plan itself was absolutely foolproof. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, this way!

760051215.text: #Looks like we don't have any other leads... Might as well follow Verna. Come on, {NICKNAME}!

760050301.text: Eureka! See? I told you to trust in the power of science...

760050303.text: Whoa! There's someone else here too!?

760050304.text: Hold on... This one seems familiar... If Paimon's memory serves, she gave us directions last time, when we ran into that giant crab!

760050305.text: But now she's shown up again... Hey, who are you, really?

760052001.text: See? All according to plan. The kuuvahki turbulence has been neutralized!

760052002.text: That was NOTHING like your original plan! With all the accidents along the way, Paimon can't tell if you're optimistic or just shameless!

760052003.text: I'll take that as a compliment! After all, being pessimistic and risk-averse won't get us through situations like this.

760052004.text: Okay... Fair enough. But Paimon can't help but wonder, why are you out here all on your own? Shouldn't the other Scions be helping out in some way?

760052005.text: Well... *sigh* Since you've helped me get this far, I suppose I should come clean. This island is... in a way, considered a forbidden place to us Frostmoon Scions. And I may have committed an even greater sin...

760052007.text: In our territories, that's not so uncommon. What truly holds people back isn't the walls they see — but the ones they've built within their hearts.

760052008.text: Since when did you get so philosophical?... Hey, wait! Don't dodge the question!

760052011.text: Ahem, seriously though... I wanted to try solving the problem using robots. You probably know this already, but most of us Frostmoon Scions aren't exactly big fans of tech.

760052012.text: I thought if my plan went well this time, maybe I could finally convince those block-headed... Well, I mean, those very steady, if rather conservative, higher-ups to reconsider their stance.

760052013.text: Hold on... I can say that, can't I? Technically, the robots were part of our operation, and since we succeeded, they clearly played their part in our success, right?

760052010.text: Hehehe, since I've been found out, there's no point keeping up the act any lon— W—Wait, wait! I'm just kidding! Don't draw your weapon!
